subject: general
question: A certain amount of money triples in 8 years under compound interest. How many years will it take for that amount to increase to nine times its original value?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In compound interest, if a sum becomes nx times in T₁ years and ny times in T₂ years, then T₁/x = T₂/y.

Sum triples (3¹ times) in 8 years → 3¹ → 8 years.

Sum becomes nine times (3² times) → 3² → 8 × 2 years.

Total time required = 16 years.

**∴ The correct option is (1).**
